prompt:
Create a new 16:9 storyboard keyframe for a music video. Image 1 is the style reference: match its 1990s hand-painted cel anime look, ink line quality, film grain and VHS softness exactly. Image 2 is SLOW's model sheet: draw SLOW exactly on-model (same face, hair, skin tone, glasses, outfit and props). Sunrise: warm golden light unifies the whole frame in full color, hopeful and bright.
Scene: Close on SLOW's notebook page filling with a slow spiral of handwriting; a pigeon lands on the stoop railing.
Camera: Over-the-shoulder close.
Characters: SLOW only, no one else unless the scene mentions extras. Their mouths are closed or relaxed (nobody is mid-word).
No readable text, letters, captions, subtitles or speech bubbles anywhere.
No borders, no panel frames, not a comic page.
